SQL:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue"
  FROM orders AS orders
  WHERE
    (
      orders.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)
      AND orders.order_date < CAST('2025-04-01' AS DATE)
    )
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
), shifted_revenue_prev_year AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date) AS "orders.order_date",
    CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue"
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', orders.order_date)
), sjoin_revenue_prev_year AS (
  SELECT
    base."orders.order_date",
    base."orders.revenue",
    shifted_revenue_prev_year."orders.revenue" AS "orders.revenue_prev_year"
  FROM base
  LEFT JOIN shifted_revenue_prev_year
    ON base."orders.order_date" - INTERVAL 1 YEAR IS NOT DISTINCT FROM shifted_revenue_prev_year."orders.order_date"
)
SELECT
  "orders.order_date",
  "orders.revenue",
  "orders.revenue_prev_year"
FROM (
  SELECT
    "orders.order_date",
    "orders.revenue",
    "orders.revenue_prev_year"
  FROM sjoin_revenue_prev_year
) AS _outer
LIMIT 21
